poll.question: Tomorrow's clear and the frame's half up—should Cole push the crew hard while Sawyer's finding his stride and winter's ticking closer, or give everyone a real rest day to

options.label: Push tomorrow
options.desc: Sawyer's confident, weather's holding, winter's close. Strike while the iron's hot.

options.label: Give them rest
options.desc: Even builders need recovery. A full day off now means better work tomorrow.

options.label: Morning work, then off
options.desc: A few hours to keep momentum, then the crew rests. Best of both.

in_play.label: First light, all day
in_play.desc: Get the walls rising while weather holds and momentum's high
